const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: D:\Programs\Hackethon\EHL-Hackathon-August-2026-Viktor\viktor-tumai-starter\scripts\plot_frontier.py

-    # Sweep how much of the router's proposal to adopt: adopt for the cheapest X% of

+    # Sweep the router proposals by marginal cost benefit. Cost-increasing
+    # proposals are dominated by retaining the logged route and must not enter a
+    # Pareto frontier. Among useful proposals, prefer savings that sacrifice the
+    # least placeholder quality per dollar.
+    useful = [r for r in recs if r["cost_routed_usd"] <= r["cost_logged_usd"]]
+    def benefit(r):
+        savings = r["cost_logged_usd"] - r["cost_routed_usd"]
+        quality_loss = (1.0 - quality(r)) * r["n_calls"]
+        return savings / max(quality_loss, 1e-12)
+    proposals = sorted(useful, key=benefit, reverse=True)
@@
-        adopt = set(id(r) for r in by_size[: int(round(frac * len(recs)))])
+        adopt = set(id(r) for r in proposals[: int(round(frac * len(proposals)))])
*** End Patch";
